name: Quvdlugiarsuaq Larva
body:
QUVDLUGIARSUAQ LARVA
CR 3

This huge, maggot-like larvae has glistening pincers and fine hair across its bulbous body..

XP 600
N Huge magical beast (cold)
Init -3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, blizzard sight; Perception -3

DEFENSE

AC 10, touch 5, flat-footed 7 (–3 Dex, +5 natural, -2 size)
hp 42 (4d10+24)
Fort +11, Ref +1, Will -2
Immune cold

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., burrow 10 ft. (ice and snow only)
Melee bite +10 (2d6+12)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks freezing spew

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 4, Con 24, Int -, Wis 5, Cha 1
Base Atk +4; CMB +14; CMD 21 (can’t be tripped)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Freezing Spew (Su)

Once per day a quvdlugiarsuaq larva can unleash a spew of fluid in a 30-foot cone that freezes on contact with a living creature. Such a creature must make a DC 19 or take 2d6 cold damage and are staggered for 1 round. A successful save halves the damage and negates the staggering.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold caves
Organization solitary
Treasure none

This massive larva is huge and fatty, and if left to grow it metamorphoses into a beautiful but terrible moth-like creature. There is a legend that a great warrior survived an entire winter in a cave off of the blubber from one of these creatures that he slew. While growing, the quvdlugiarsuaq larva feeds upon small creatures that it freezes with its spew. While they rarely hunt humans, if one comes into its cave, they will not turn down easy prey.
